title: Luxury  Retreat Home  in the Heart of 12 South
description:
Beautiful, architect designed home, 4500 sf, 100 yr old home turned modern masterpiece in the heart of the most sought after neighborhood! 3 minute walk to all the shops and restaurants of 12 South. Belmont University, Vanderbilt, The Gulch and Broadway are all 5 minutes from this centrally located part of town that boasts some of the most famous shops and restaurants in town. Walk to coffee shops, cafes, boutiques, and more.

The space
This modern home is overflowing with light. There are three levels plus 4 outdoor living spaces to enjoy, a wet bar on every floor, Jacuzzi tub, outdoor kitchen, and so many more luxury amenities to enjoy.

Huge king master suite with marble bathroom and double shower and tub.  So many living spaces.  Great for big groups, business retreats, and family gatherings.   
additional bedrooms.

There is a roof deck, a balcony off the master, plus an outdoor living room on the main floor with fireplace and TV.

The house is equipped with everything you will need to enjoy your stay. Provisioning is also available, so please let us know if you would like the kitchen and bar stocked for your arrival.

Guest access
The house is yours.  If you are interested in the guest house, let us know!
